sec.title: August 28 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 269)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 28** across American network radio and syndication, Louise Erickson getting a glamorous new hairstyle on *A Date with Judy* for Old Gold, *Famous Jury Trials: The State vs. Daniel Morgan*, two Nick & Nora Charles mysteries on *The Thin Man* (1946 straw hat murder and 1947 Post's Raisin Bran diamond collar theft), and Glenn Langan solving a soundproof booth murder in *Mystery Is My Hobby* (1945–1948):
